gcm.purpose: Build and regression-test the Client Health v2 evidence-based scoring contract.
changeNotes: Adds deterministic Client Health v2 scoring with confidence, trend, ten health dimensions, and a client-safe summary layer.
Unknown dimensions reduce confidence instead of reducing the health score.
Wires Client Health v2 into the existing D1 client workspace without replacing the current v1 UI field yet.
